current_evidence: Hackney's 'Submit a planning application' page has a 'Validation checklists' section that links the 'planning application validation checklist (google doc)', plus a separate householder checklist and a majors supporting-documents PDF on Google Drive. The Google Doc text shows no adoption or revision date.

issues.detail: Grokbot's 'Validation list URL' is the general how-to page for submitting an application, not the local validation list. The page itself links the actual 'Planning Application Validation Checklist' (Google Doc), a 'validation checklist for householder planning applications' and 'supporting document requirements for major planning applications'. Grokbot did not follow any of them, so only 3 items were captured.
issues.evidence: Page section 'Validation checklists' -> 'planning application validation checklist (google doc)'

issues.detail: Both tab_items are not requirements. One is a pointer to the non-statutory planning administration fees (pre-app advice, document requests, validation support). The other is 'Search for / comment on a planning application ... up to 5 working days for planning documents to appear', which is process and website text.
issues.evidence: 'See non-statutory planning administration fees (Google Doc)'; 'It can take up to 5 working days for planning documents to appear on the system'

issues.detail: The local drawing requirements were missed, apart from the generic floor plans and elevations: site sections with finished floor and site levels; roof plans; pre-existing plans for retrospective or commenced works; photographs/photomontages (all majors with at least 2 3D visuals, new buildings affecting the streetscene, conservation area or listed building, telecoms masts); landscaping scheme (all majors); schedule of materials (majors, listed buildings, conservation areas, LBC); Urban Greening Factor drawing and calculation (all majors); parking/access details; refuse and recycling details (additional units or change of use); flues and extraction details (cooked food, laundrettes, plant).

The housing requirements were missed. Affordable Housing Statement and Viability Report: 10+ units or sites over 1,000 sq m or 0.1 ha, housing regeneration, or 1-9 units with no financial contribution under LP33. Small sites agreement / Unilateral Undertaking: 1-9 additional units. S106 draft heads of terms: all majors and any application proposing new residential units. Child Friendly Impact Assessment: child yield of 10 or more. Health Impact Assessment: 50+ units, non-residential floorspace of 10,000 sq m or more, takeaways, betting shops and payday loan shops. Management Plan: large HMOs (7+), student housing, hostels, night-time economy uses, mini-cab offices, street markets.

The commercial requirements were missed. Affordable Workspace Statement: major commercial schemes, or major mixed-use schemes in designated employment areas. Marketing Strategy: new commercial floorspace. BREEAM Pre-Assessment: non-residential new units or extensions of 100 sq m or more. Sequential Test and Impact Assessment: edge- or out-of-centre E(a)/E(b)/leisure over 200 sq m GFA. Marketing Evidence: net loss of industrial floorspace outside a PIA, loss of E(g)(i) office outside a POA, loss of retail, places of worship, or social/community facilities, and demolition of a designated heritage asset.

The environment and energy requirements were missed. Energy Strategy Statement: all majors, 1+ residential units, and any non-residential new floorspace. Sustainability Impact Assessment: 1,000 sq m GIA or more, 1+ residential units, or sites of 0.5 ha/1 ha or more. Whole Life Carbon and Circular Economy Statements: majors referable to the Mayor. SuDS strategy and proforma: all majors. Overheating Risk Assessment: all majors, and minors installing air conditioning. Daylight/Sunlight: majors, or where neighbours are affected. Air Quality Assessment: majors, areas of poor air quality, sensitive uses, significant demolition. Noise Impact Assessment and sound insulation details: E(a)/E(b), takeaways, pubs, conversions, residential near noise. Contaminated Land Assessment. Site Waste Management Plan. Be Seen commitment: all major and minor. Environmental Statement: EIA. Fire Safety Reasonable Exception Statement.

The flood, ecology, heritage, transport and telecoms requirements were missed. Flood Risk Assessment: Flood Zones 2/3; sites over 1 ha in FZ1; more vulnerable uses; majors and basements in Critical Drainage Areas. Draft Biodiversity Gain Plan: all non-exempt applications. Biodiversity Survey: majors, and sites near SINCs, watercourses, Walthamstow Reservoirs SPA or SSSIs. Archaeological Assessment: ground disturbance on or adjoining an archaeological site. Heritage Statement: listed or locally listed buildings, conservation areas, Scheduled Monuments, Registered Parks, non-designated heritage assets, LBC. Structural Survey: demolition or conversion of a listed building. Tall Buildings Assessment: 30 m+ or 50% above prevailing height. TVIA: strategic views such as King Henry's Mound to St Paul's. Wind Impact Statement. Tree Survey: works affecting trees on or off site. Transport Assessment: majors. Transport Statement: up to 9 units or under 1,000 sq m with transport implications. Travel Plan. ICNIRP statement: telecoms. Planning Statement: majors and where obligations apply.
issues.evidence: Checklist sections 'Flood Risk and Drainage', 'Biodiversity and Ecology', 'Heritage and Design', 'Transport', 'Telecommunications', 'Supporting Statements'

issues.detail: The Design and Access Statement is recorded as 'only required if the property is within a conservation area'. That simplified line comes from the how-to page. The validation checklist lists the DAS under national requirements, and statutorily it is also required for all major development and LBC. Grokbot's trigger understates when it applies. The 'Block plan / Site plan' and 'Floor plans / Elevations' excerpts are a run-on copy of the page's whole basic document list, not triggers.
issues.evidence: How-to page: 'a design and access statement (only required if the property is within a conservation area)'; checklist National Requirements includes 'Design and Access Statement'

issues.detail: Grokbot places all three captured items under Full planning ('INFERRED ... placed under Full planning') and marks Householder, Outline, S73 and LBC as '(none)'. The checklist states that it applies to Householder, Full, Outline (some or all matters reserved), and Variation/Removal of Conditions, and that LBC documents are required where stated. A separate householder validation checklist also exists. The '(none)' rows for these types are wrong.
issues.evidence: Checklist scope: 'applies to the following forms of planning applications: householder planning consent, full planning permission, outline planning permission ... variation or removal of conditions'

issues.detail: The planning.data.gov.uk record that Grokbot read (hackney-validation-checklist, entry-date 2026-10-16) points to a Google Drive file 'vc-Full-Planning-Permission.pdf', but Grokbot did not use it. Neither that file nor the Google Doc shows an adoption or revision date, so 'Undated' is correct, but the list is not 'Captured'.

summary: Grokbot linked Hackney's general 'submit a planning application' page instead of the validation checklist Google Doc that the page links, so it captured only two non-requirement snippets and three generic plan/DAS items. Virtually the entire local list (around 50 requirements, covering affordable housing, energy, flood, heritage, transport and more) is missing, and Householder, Outline and S73 are wrongly shown as having no local requirements.
